# Notation System Usage

A reified, role- and period-scoped use of a notation system by an entity — an observation in the universal claim stack (#69): the gufo:Relator binding {entity} × {notation system} × {role} × {period}, mirroring names' NameUsage and languages' WritingSystemUsage. Lets a language use IPA for phonetic transcription, a musical work use Western staff notation, or a text use Morse code for encoding, each co-equally and standpoint-scoped.
